name: 04-speech-pause-pattern-analyzer
description: Educational speech pause and filler pattern analyzer using Web Speech API and whole-word regex

scripts.test: node -e "const { analyzeSpeechPatterns, SAMPLE_SPEECH, configuredFillers } = require('./script.js'); const res = analyzeSpeechPatterns(SAMPLE_SPEECH, configuredFillers, [], 30); if (res.totalFillers < 5) throw new Error('Expected >= 5 fillers'); console.log('All tests passed!');"
scripts.dev: node -e "const http = require('http'), fs = require('fs'), path = require('path'); const port = 3004; http.createServer((req, res) => { const file = req.url === '/' ? 'index.html' : req.url.slice(1).split('?')[0]; const filePath = path.join(__dirname, file); if (!fs.existsSync(filePath)) { res.writeHead(404); return res.end('Not Found'); } const ext = path.extname(filePath); const types = { '.html': 'text/html', '.css': 'text/css', '.js': 'text/javascript' }; res.writeHead(200, { 'Content-Type': types[ext] || 'text/plain' }); fs.createReadStream(filePath).pipe(res); }).listen(port, () => console.log('Project 4 running at http://localhost:' + port));"

author: Computer Science Engineering Student
